questions.stem: A box contains $4$ red and $6$ green sweets. Two sweets are taken without replacement. What is $P(\text{both red})$?
questions.explanation: $P(\text{1st red}) = \frac{4}{10}$. After removing a red, $P(\text{2nd red}) = \frac{3}{9}$. $P(\text{both red}) = \frac{4}{10} \times \frac{3}{9} = \frac{12}{90} = \frac{2}{15}$.
